::: {#def-brnffrcistg .theorem}
## BRNFFRCISTG model

A bipartite random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (BRNFFRCISTG) is a causal model $\mathcal C = (\mathcal M, \mathcal M^{(\Gamma)})$ of a [BRNNPSEM](#def-bipartite-npsem-ie) $\mathcal M$ that satisfies the conditions of an [RNFFRCISTG](#def-rnffrcitg), except that single-world independence takes each $\boldsymbol\Psi_i$, rather than each graph generator, as a single variable.
:::
